message: this signature declares 65 type variables, and the evidence word carries 64
label: too many type variables for one word
notes: a symbolic witness reads its bit with a shift by the variable's index, and a shift of 64 or more is poison in the emitted LLVM - an arbitrary answer at run time, which under reference maps is a wrong free; the widest signature in this repository declares 4
help: split the declaration, or make some positions concrete - each variable needs one bit
